sentences.text: Prayer: Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution o  praying to issue a Writ of Mandamus to direct the respondents 1 to   determine compensation payable to petitioner in respect of the  aforementioned acquired parts of lands compromised in Survey No.132  vide Patta No.3082, measuring an extent of Hectare 02-67.00 Ares of  Agiruculture land in Serpedu Village, Gummidi  Thiruvallur District,

in accordance with right to fair compensation  transparency in land acquisition, rehabilitation & resettlement Act  or any other equivalent or appropriate act and pay the compensation  tune with market value with solatium, interest, betterment charges
For petitioner : Mr.K.Yuvaraj
For Respondents : Mr.P.Sathish  Additional Government P https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 25/03/2025 02:07:48 pm )

 ORDER

This writ petition has been filed for the issue of writ of mandamus directing the respondents to determine the compensation amount payable to the petitioner with respect to the subject property which was utilized by the respondents for laying the road without following the due process of law.
2.When the matter was taken up for hearing on 18.02.2025, this Court directed the learned Additional Government Pleader to take instructions in this case.
